ledger: Woman (main subject) | walking through market aisle, right hand gripping blue umbrella shaft at chest height, left hand holding red fruit near shaft | left hand open-palmed with red fruit apparently unsupported, umbrella shaft passes up behind her shoulder with gripping hand out of frame | left-hand grip on fruit visibly degrades ~0:06-0:08 from held to apparently floating; right-hand umbrella grip becomes occluded/out of frame ~0:08
Blue umbrella | held aloft, shaft gripped by woman's right hand | shaft still upright above/behind woman, no hand visibly contacting shaft in frame | continuous carry, no visible release or transfer

Red fruit | held in woman's left hand, pressed near umbrella shaft | positioned in front of her open left palm with fingers spread, no visible finger contact | contact with fingers lost around 0:06 and remains absent through 0:08
Background pedestrians | walking through aisle at normal gait, some carrying bags | continue walking past stalls | no contact or support anomalies observed

findings.entity: red fruit in woman's left hand
findings.description: From 0:06 onward the fruit sits directly in front of the woman's open left hand with fingers spread and thumb extended; no finger wraps, pinches, or presses against the fruit, yet it maintains a fixed position relative to the hand as if supported. By 0:08 it clearly hovers above the open palm with a visible gap, with no contact surface explaining its support.
